name: Space radiation
summary: Radiation in space is invisible and is considered one of the most hazardous aspects of spaceflight.

name: Isolation and confinement
summary: Crews live isolated and confined in a small space for months or years, which affects behavior and teamwork.

name: Distance from Earth
summary: A Mars mission means roughly three years away from Earth, so planning and self-sufficiency are key.

name: Gravity fields
summary: Muscles, bones, the inner ear and organs must adjust to each new gravity level the crew encounters.

name: Hostile and closed environments
summary: The spacecraft is a closed ecosystem: temperature, pressure, lighting, noise and air quality shape daily life.
